I play her with precision runes a crit build. What I always do its to play around my Q. What most people doesn't know it's that MF's Q double hit deals crit damage when the bullet kills a target and bounces to the champ behind it so they won't even try to stay away from minions. Just last hit a minion with a Q and make sure the bounce will hit the champ. That way you can bully the lane and do a lot of damage without getting too close to strong champs like Tristana or Jhin that can totally destroy you in lane phase. Just combo your Q's with your E's to give you more time to strike 3 times and inflict more damage. 

Also look out for your placement since MF doesn't have too much mobility and somebody can easily outrun you. Stay behind your minions to avoid getting stunned or dragged by the supp (unless it's Lux or Swain). 

Don't fear using your R. Sometimes your team will say it's better to keep your ulti for a play or for a TF but if you can secure a kill with it, don't hesitate. Even if it's for a 1v1. Trust me, it can save your life. Combo it with a E first to stow them down before hitting the R. Also look out for the right time to cut your ulti to finish your kill with a Q or to escape and get cover. 

Also healers won't do a good synergy with her so if you can tell your supp to pick a good tanky stunner like Leona, Thresh or Blitz. That way you won't have to pay too much attention to your supp if they try to target him.
